skills.name: apxm-ais-op-design
skills.description: Use before adding or modifying an AIS op in apxm-core. Enforces the design-before-code gate, the canonical-attribute rule, and the build-dialect + codegen cadence.

skills.name: apxm-backend-add
skills.description: Use when registering a new APXM inference backend (cloud, on-prem, or local). Enforces hard-fail-at-config-time resolver behavior.

skills.name: apxm-commit
skills.description: Commit gate — runs apxm-simplify + apxm-finish first, drafts message in repo log style, lints it with dekk apxm commit-lint, commits at a clean stopping point, and pushes only when authorized. Never --force. Does not open PRs.

skills.name: apxm-compile-and-execute
skills.description: Use when compiling APXM AIR workflows, running .apxmobj artifacts, or executing AIR/IR through the runtime. Enforces dekk apxm as the authority CLI and correct artifact placement under .apxm/.

skills.name: apxm-context
skills.description: Prime an APXM session before broad work — runs doctor, reads project.md and the relevant _shared rules, surfaces subsystem ownership, and recalls APXM memory. Run at the start of any session that will touch >1 file or any non-trivial change.

skills.name: apxm-design-docs
skills.description: Use when editing conceptual docs under docs/design/. Gates two shipped failure modes — overclaim (present-tense prose about unwired behaviour) and citation drift (claims with no anchor to shipped code).

skills.name: apxm-execute-plan
skills.description: Drive an APXM plan to completion without scope creep. Tracks phases with the harness's task tracker, runs focused per-phase verification, refuses to add features beyond the plan, and surfaces blockers immediately. Invoke only after apxm-plan produces an approved plan.

skills.name: apxm-finish
skills.description: Pre-claim gate — runs focused dekk apxm test, doctor, release checks when relevant, secrets scan, and artifact-placement check before any claim of completion. Refuses to claim done until all pass.

skills.name: apxm-fork-vllm-rebase
skills.description: Use when rebasing the external/vllm fork onto a new upstream tag, cherry-picking APXM commits, or resolving conflicts in the fork. Covers the G1 build/smoke gate.

skills.name: apxm-goal-orchestrator
skills.description: Use when an agent should turn a complex APXM goal into a bounded worker workflow, execute it through APXM, wait on goal events/status, and synthesize verified artifacts. Covers `dekk apxm goal`, `goal_start`, `goal_*`, workflow drill-down, and `prompt_as_workflow` selection.

skills.name: apxm-mcp-server
skills.description: Use when working on APXM MCP surfaces: the Rust HTTP `/v1/mcp` endpoint, the Rust stdio `apxm-mcp-server` binary, or cross-agent MCP registration. Prefer server-owned HTTP MCP for workflow/orchestration control.

skills.name: apxm-mlir-pass-development
skills.description: Use when adding, modifying, or reordering MLIR passes in the APXM compiler pipeline. Enforces the single pass-list source of truth, the AIS-core ownership rule, and the build-dialect + codegen cadence after .td edits.

skills.name: apxm-model-zoo-operate
skills.description: Use when adding, scaling, or probing models in the vLLM zoo (deploy/vllm/zoo*.toml). Enforces docker-load then cache-warm then zoo-apply then service-exec/status; use the zoo surface only.

skills.name: apxm-plan
skills.description: Produce a written plan before non-trivial APXM implementation. Required for changes touching >3 files, modifying a public API or AIS op, or needing Slurm GPU allocation. Enforces APXM-specific gates (AIS-op-vs-compose decision, dialect-codegen impact).

skills.name: apxm-simplify
skills.description: Pre-finish review pass — remove copied _shared text, weak abstractions, referential comments, and over-large skill bodies before claiming completion. Mandatory before apxm-finish and any commit.

skills.name: apxm-vllm-service
skills.description: Use when building, launching, probing, or running APXM workloads against the Dockerized APXM-vLLM backend, especially on Slurm compute nodes. Enforces Dekk as the authority CLI, persistent service allocations, image-store reuse, and service-exec for commands that need the vLLM endpoint.
